identity: Maastricht University European Studies BA, English full time, September 2026

sources.scope: Adopted EER Article 3.6.3, elective rules and Article 7.3.
FASoS Rules and Regulations Article 5 and implementation rules for electives and exchange.

curriculum: The 180 EC degree comprises three 60 EC years. Year one includes four 9 EC courses and six credited skills elements. Year two includes four 9 EC courses, the three-part 13 EC Academic Workshop II, 3 EC second language and 8 EC of methods. One period-4 course is chosen from three and one period-5 course from four. Semester five has 24 EC of electives, minor, study abroad, internship or approved combinations. The final 36 EC includes two restricted-choice courses worth 9 and 6 EC and either the 17 EC thesis with one 4 EC methods course or the 21 EC Final Project. The example uses first-listed options independently of the UCR fit. The Final Project admits up to 40 students in registration order. The thesis route uses EUS3500, Interviewing, with EUS3900 running in periods 3–6.
progression: Article 7.3 gives positive first-year advice at 45.5 EC or more, negative advice below 30 EC and conditional continuation under the regulations between 30 and 45 EC. The third-year choice remains open and subject to applicable faculty, external elective, exchange and internship approval rules. Academic Workshops and introductory research methods precede the final-work year. The thesis-route 4 EC skills course is required alongside the thesis. Two appointed examiners assess the final work and must agree on grade and rationale; a third examiner can be appointed if agreement fails. The optional zero-credit mentor programmes do not add credits.
